name: Machine Standing Calf Raise
steps: Set your shoulders under the pads and place the balls of your feet on the footplate with your heels free.
Stand straight up with your knees softly unlocked, core braced, and hands resting lightly on the shoulder pad handles.
Lower your heels until you feel comfortable tension through both calves.
Push through the balls of both feet to lift your heels, then lower them under control.
tips: Keep your knees stationary throughout so you do not bounce the load up with your legs.
Pause smoothly at the bottom stretch to remove momentum from each repetition.
